description:
Job Title: Warehouse Manager – E-commerce Operations

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager with strong practical knowledge of **EasyEcom WMS/OMS** to manage end-to-end warehouse and e-commerce operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Shopify.

The candidate will be responsible for inventory control, order processing, warehouse team management, dispatch operations, returns and marketplace coordination.

Key Responsibilities

**1. EasyEcom WMS/OMS Management**

* Hands-on experience in EasyEcom WMS and OMS is mandatory.
* Manage inventory, SKU mapping, warehouse-wise stock and bin locations.
* Monitor order synchronisation from Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Shopify.
* Manage order allocation, picking lists, packing and dispatch processing.
* Handle stock adjustments, inward entries, stock transfers and inventory reconciliation.
* Monitor pending, failed, cancelled and returned orders.
* Coordinate with EasyEcom support for technical and integration issues.
* Ensure accurate and timely system updates.

**2. Marketplace Operations**

* Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central.
* Amazon FBA, FBM and Easy Ship.
* Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Myntra Partner Portal.
* Shopify / D2C website orders.
* B2B and bulk order processing.

**3. Warehouse & Inventory Operations**

* Manage inward, GRN, put-away, picking, packing and dispatch.
* Maintain SKU-wise inventory accuracy.
* Conduct daily cycle counts and monthly stock audits.
* Control damaged, defective, missing and excess inventory.
* Manage stock transfers between multiple warehouses.
* Maintain proper warehouse discipline and housekeeping.

**4. Logistics & Dispatch**

* Coordinate with courier partners and transporters.
* Plan daily dispatches and vehicle loading.
* Monitor marketplace dispatch SLAs and pending shipments.
* Manage Amazon FC appointments, shipment creation and replenishment.
* Ensure invoices, labels, e-way bills and dispatch documentation.

**5. Returns & MIS Reporting**

* Manage customer returns, RTO and reverse logistics.
* Prepare daily reports for orders, dispatches, inventory and pending shipments.
* Monitor warehouse productivity and operational costs.
* Coordinate with finance, purchase, sales and customer support teams.

**6. Team Management**

* Supervise warehouse executives, pickers, packers and dispatch staff.
* Allocate daily tasks and monitor employee performance.
* Manage attendance, shift schedules and warehouse discipline.

Required Skills

* 3–6 years of warehouse/e-commerce operations experience.
* **Mandatory: Hands-on EasyEcom WMS/OMS experience.**
* Strong knowledge of Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra operations.
* Practical knowledge of Shopify order processing.
* Advanced Excel and MIS reporting.
* Knowledge of SKU mapping, inventory reconciliation and multi-warehouse management.
* Good team-handling and communication skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* EasyEcom system and physical inventory accuracy.
* Order processing and dispatch within SLA.
* Picking and packing accuracy.
* Reduction in cancellations and inventory mismatches.
* Returns processing efficiency.
* Warehouse manpower productivity.

**Preference:** Candidates who have independently managed EasyEcom WMS/OMS and multi-channel e-commerce warehouse operations will be given priority.

Job Type: Full-time

description:
**Job Title: Director of Engineering**

**About the Role**

Dash Technologies is a US-headquartered software services company building AI-first solutions for healthcare and enterprise clients. We are looking for a Director of Engineering who can lead both technical engineering excellence and delivery execution in a fast-paced services environment with deep fluency in the US healthcare ecosystem.

This is the senior-most engineering and delivery role in the organization. It reports directly to the CEO, and the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 30-40 team members (direct and indirect reports) reports into this role, including 5-10 US-based team members managed remotely from India. The role owns a portfolio of approximately 20 customers, of which five are blue-chip accounts requiring direct engagement with client CEOs and CIOs. The portfolio is approximately 70% US healthcare engagements and 30% other technology engagements.

This role is a member of the company's leadership team and participates in all monthly and quarterly business reviews. This is not a 9-to-5 job it demands an always-on ownership mindset, with genuine care for customers and an unwavering commitment to delivery.

This role is responsible for building AI-first engineering capabilities while ensuring high-quality, predictable delivery across multiple US client engagements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with strong delivery discipline, proven US healthcare domain experience, and exceptional people and client management skills the ability to build genuine, lasting relationships with team members, clients, and senior client executives is mandatory for success in this role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Engineering Leadership**

* + Lead the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 60 direct and indirect reports, including engineering managers, tech leads, and delivery teams
  + Directly manage 5–10 US-based team members from India, ensuring cohesion, accountability, and performance across geographies
  + Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable, secure, high-quality software systems
  + Establish and enforce engineering best practices across teams
  + Mentor engineering managers, tech leads, and senior developers
  + Ensure strong code quality, system performance, and reliability

**Healthcare Domain Leadership**

* + Bring a working understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain providers, payers, MedTech, digital health, and life sciences
  + Guide teams building on and integrating with EMR/EHR platforms or any strong compliance domain experience.

**AI & Innovation**

* + Drive adoption of AI/ML, LLMs, and intelligent automation across projects, including healthcare-specific AI use cases
  + Build reusable AI accelerators and frameworks to improve delivery efficiency
  + Enable teams to leverage AI-assisted development tools
  + Partner with leadership to define and execute AI-driven service offerings

**Delivery Ownership**

* + Own end-to-end delivery across multiple US client projects
  + Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality
  + Implement strong execution frameworks (Agile, sprint discipline, milestone tracking)
  + Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

About the Position

We are hiring an **Amazon PPC Executive** who can independently manage Amazon advertising campaigns, analyze performance, and identify opportunities for profitable growth.

This position is primarily focused on **Amazon Advertising (70%)**, with supporting responsibilities in **Seller Central Operations (30%)**.

We are looking for someone who goes beyond routine campaign monitoring, understands advertising performance, and takes ownership of results.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Amazon Advertising & PPC Optimization – 70%**

* Plan, create, manage, and optimize Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

We actively encourage the use of AI and technology to improve advertising performance and operational efficiency.

Candidates should be comfortable learning and working with tools such as:

* **ChatGPT & Google Gemini:** Data interpretation, reporting, research, content analysis, and workflow assistance.

* **Microsoft Excel & Google Sheets:** Advanced reporting, data analysis, bulk operations, and performance tracking.
* **Amazon Ads Console & Bulk Sheets:** Campaign management, large-scale optimization, and advertising reporting.

The ideal candidate should be able to identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation, use AI to assist decision-making, and validate recommendations against actual marketplace data.

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
**Job Summary :**

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for developing and executing assortment and inventory strategies that drive sales, gross margin, and inventory productivity across assigned client’s retail locations. This role owns vendor partnerships, negotiates cost and commercial terms, and ensures optimal product mix between Client’s internal and third-party brands where applicable. The Procurement Specialist actively manages budgets, sell-through, and aging inventory, collaborates cross-functionally on pricing and promotional strategy, and ensures compliance. The role leverages data analytics and market insights to optimize category performance and support Client’s financial objectives.

**Job Duties :** Core duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

**Assortment Architecture & Strategy :**

* Assist the Client’s Leadership in developing assortment architectures that account for price bands, depth of choice, and key vendor partnerships across all retail locations.
* Support the Client’s assortment architecture initiative by assigning brands to pricing tiers based on product quality and cost, including recommended retail pricing and promotional components.
* Monitor shifts in consumer purchasing behavior by package size and adjust assortment, pricing, and promotional strategy to protect profitability.
* Actively manage the full product lifecycle from introduction through maturity and exit, ensuring disciplined SKU onboarding, performance tracking, and rationalization.

**Buying & Purchasing Operations :**

* Responsible for identifying, selecting, and purchasing internal and third-party products for assigned retail locations in adherence with the 5 Rights of Buying: Right Quality, Right Quantity, Right Price, Right Placement, and Right Timing.
* Maintain purchase orders and track information in the designated system, ensuring orders are received in full at designated locations and that Accounting has the necessary information to complete vendor payment within agreed-upon terms.
* Support monthly Open-to-Buy budgets and report performance to company leadership.

**Vendor Partnerships & Negotiations :**

* Create and maintain effective partnerships with new and existing vendors, negotiating terms, pricing, and supply agreements; partner with applicable internal departments to develop and execute specific terms where applicable.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners on incoming brands, product education, and assortment updates.
* Stay connected to the industry and react with urgency to market trends through frequent communication with field teams and consistent review of market data available through various third party platforms.

**Pricing Strategy & Margin Ownership :**

* Collaborate with the Client’s Leadership and Executive team to develop a pricing strategy that is competitive in the market and achieves targeted margin thresholds.
* Own category gross margin performance with accountability for both gross margin dollars (GM$) and gross margin rate (GM%), ensuring assortment and pricing decisions maximize absolute profit contribution.

**Promotional Strategy & Inventory Health :**

* Partner with Retail and Marketing teams to strategically deploy promotions and markdowns that accelerate aged inventory while protecting brand integrity and profitability.
* Recommend and inform monthly and seasonal promotional calendars, aligning vendor funding, internal brand priorities, and inventory health objectives.

**Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration :**

* Work closely with Retail Leaders and Merchandise Planning on sales and inventory reporting to ensure stores maintain adequate supply in key categories and products.
* Collaborate with fellow Buyers, Merchandise Planning, and the Business Strategy team to develop and maintain robust sales reporting and product performance metrics down to the SKU level as needed.
* Coordinate with US-based teams during the night shift.

**Job Requirements :**

* Retail Management or related field, 5+ years’ experience or equivalent
* Prior experience in Retail Market / US Geography
* Experience with ERP and/or Inventory Management systems; advanced Microsoft Excel skills required.
* Proven ability to establish strong credibility and build relationships, operate in an environment of ambiguity, and maintain strict confidentiality.
* Highly analytical, capable of turning raw data into information and insights.
* Strong financial acumen and analytical skills, prior experience developing and managing a budget.
* Excellent organizational skills, ability to develop and implement operational best practices.
* Good judgment in a fast-moving environment with the ability to prioritize and execute multiple tasks with urgency.
* Must possess excellent business judgment, strong written and oral communication skills, and a can-do, common-sense approach to getting things done.

**Job overview**

As a Credit Controller at Pluto Travels, you will play a pivotal role in managing and overseeing the company’s credit control function. You will be responsible for ensuring that all payments are collected in a timely manner, monitoring overdue accounts, and resolving any customer issues related to credit and payment. **Key Result Areas**

· **Monitor Debtor Accounts:** Regularly review and manage overdue account balances, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records of all outstanding debts.

· **Reporting:** Report any payment issues, discrepancies, or concerns to management or the appropriate team to facilitate prompt resolution and prevent potential cash flow problems.

· **Credit Assessments:** Evaluate and assess creditworthiness of new and existing customers, and recommend appropriate credit limits and terms.

· **Invoicing:** Oversee the generation and delivery of accurate invoices to customers and ensure that any issues with invoicing are resolved swiftly.

· **Documentation:** Maintain comprehensive records of all credit control activities, including correspondence with customers, payment arrangements, and collection efforts.

· **Reconciliation:** Perform regular reconciliation of customer accounts and resolve any discrepancies between customer accounts and company records.

· **Compliance:** Ensure that all credit control procedures and processes comply with company policies and relevant regulations.

· **Collaboration:** Work closely with the sales and finance teams to ensure alignment between credit control activities and overall business objectives.

This job specification is intended to convey the essential requirements and expectations for the Credit Controller role. It is not exhaustive and may be subject to change based on organizational needs and priorities.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION (JD)**

**Export Documentation, International Sales & Lead Generation**

**Company Name:** Blacksmith Woven Conversion Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Export Sales & Marketing  
**Job Title:** Export Documentation & International Sales Manager / Senior Executive  
**Experience Required:** 5–10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** Machinery Manufacturing & Export

**1. About the Company**

Blacksmith Woven Conversion Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer and exporter of plant and machinery for the woven sack bag-making and closing industries. The company focuses on delivering quality machinery and solutions to domestic and international customers.

**2. Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented professional with 5–10 years of experience in export documentation, international sales, lead generation, and export coordination.

The candidate will be responsible for managing export documentation, developing international markets, generating new business leads, handling customer inquiries, coordinating shipments, and converting prospective customers into confirmed orders.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of export procedures, international trade documentation, customer relationship management, and business development, preferably in the machinery manufacturing or industrial equipment sector.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Export Documentation & Compliance**

* Prepare, verify, and maintain export documentation for domestic and international shipments.
* Prepare commercial invoices, proforma invoices, packing lists, purchase orders, and shipping instructions.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping companies, and logistics service providers.
* Coordinate the preparation and processing of shipping bills, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and other applicable export documents.
* Handle documentation related to Letters of Credit (LC), advance payments, and other agreed payment terms.
* Coordinate with banks regarding export-related documentation and payment realization, where applicable.
* Maintain records of export orders, shipment details, dispatch schedules, and customer transactions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable export regulations, customs requirements, and company procedures.
* Coordinate with the production, quality, accounts, and dispatch departments to ensure timely shipment of machinery.
* Track shipment status and promptly communicate updates to international customers.
* Verify document accuracy and resolve discrepancies before shipment.
* Maintain systematic records of export transactions and documentation for audits and future reference.

**B. International Sales & Business Development**

* Develop new business opportunities in international markets for the company's machinery and equipment.
* Identify potential buyers, importers, distributors, dealers, and industrial customers.
* Handle international sales inquiries received through email, telephone, websites, LinkedIn, and B2B platforms.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable machinery and solutions.
* Prepare quotations, proforma invoices, commercial proposals, and product presentations.
* Follow up with prospective customers regarding quotations, pricing, technical specifications, and order confirmation.
* Coordinate with the technical team to address customer queries about machine specifications and applications.
* Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms within company-approved limits.
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with international customers and business partners.
* Monitor sales opportunities from initial inquiry through negotiation and order confirmation.
* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth execution of confirmed export orders.
* Work toward achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.

**C. Lead Generation & Market Research**

* Generate qualified business leads through LinkedIn, IndiaMART, Alibaba, trade directories, company websites, and other relevant B2B platforms.
* Research international markets to identify potential customers for woven sack bag-making and closing machinery.
* Identify target countries, industries, distributors, importers, and machinery dealers.
* Build and maintain a database of potential customers, including company names, contact persons, email addresses, telephone numbers, and business requirements.
* Conduct professional email outreach and follow-up campaigns to generate sales inquiries.
* Use online research and networking platforms to identify new business opportunities.
* Qualify leads based on customer requirements, purchasing potential, market suitability, and budget.
* Schedule meetings and online presentations with prospective customers.
* Maintain an updated lead pipeline and report lead status to management.
* Track lead conversion rates and improve lead generation strategies.
* Support the development of new export markets and customer segments.

**D. Customer Relationship Management**

* Maintain regular communication with existing and prospective customers.
* Respond promptly to customer inquiries and provide accurate product information.
* Coordinate with customers regarding quotations, payment terms, production timelines, and shipment schedules.
* Handle customer concerns professionally and coordinate with relevant departments for resolution.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, inquiries, quotations, and sales follow-ups.
* Ensure customer satisfaction and encourage repeat business and referrals.

**E. Export Order & Shipment Coordination**

* Coordinate with the production department to monitor order progress and delivery commitments.
* Arrange shipment planning in coordination with logistics providers.
* Verify packing details and shipping requirements for machinery exports.
* Coordinate with the dispatch and accounts departments for invoices, payment status, and shipment clearance.
* Keep customers informed about production progress, dispatch dates, and shipment tracking.
* Ensure all required documents are prepared before shipment.
* Follow up on outstanding export payments and coordinate with the accounts department for payment realization.

**F. Reporting & Documentation Management**

* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on export sales, leads generated, inquiries received, and orders confirmed.
* Maintain records of quotations, customer follow-ups, sales pipelines, and export shipments.
* Prepare market research reports and competitor analysis.
* Monitor sales performance against assigned targets.
* Provide regular updates to management regarding business opportunities, customer feedback, and market developments.
* Maintain organized digital records of all export and sales-related documents.

**4. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, International Business, or a related field.
* MBA in International Business, Marketing, or Export Management will be an added advantage.
* Relevant professional qualifications in export-import management will be preferred.

**5. Experience Required**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in export documentation, international sales, export coordination, or business development.
* Practical experience in handling export shipments and preparing commercial and shipping documents.
* Experience in international lead generation and customer acquisition.
* Experience in machinery manufacturing, industrial equipment, engineering products, or capital goods exports will be highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage customer inquiries, prepare quotations, and follow up on sales opportunities.

**6. Technical Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of export-import procedures and international trade documentation.
* Understanding of Incoterms, such as EXW, FOB, CIF, and CFR.
* Knowledge of shipping procedures, freight forwarding, and customs clearance coordination.
* Understanding of Letters of Credit, advance payments, and international payment procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and professional email communication.
* Experience using CRM software and online B2B lead generation platforms.
* Knowledge of international market research and customer database management.
* Ability to prepare professional quotations, invoices, and sales reports.

**7. Required Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong negotiation and customer-handling abilities.
* Good organizational and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical and market research capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple customers and export orders simultaneously.
* Target-oriented approach and problem-solving ability.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**8. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on the following:

* Number of qualified international leads generated.
* Number of new customers and business opportunities developed.
* Conversion rate of inquiries and quotations into confirmed orders.
* Achievement of assigned sales and export revenue targets.
* Accuracy and timely preparation of export documentation.
* Timely coordination and dispatch of export orders.
* Customer follow-up efficiency and satisfaction.
* Development of new international markets.
* Timely submission of sales and export reports.

**9. Salary & Benefits**

* Salary: As per company standards and candidate experience.
* Other benefits: As per company policy

title: Admin & Facility Executive
description:
**Job Description – Travel Desk Executive**
===========================================

**Company:** Anblicks

**Position:** Travel Desk Executive

**Department:** Administration / Finance & Operations

**Location:** India

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Work Timing:** India working hours with required overlap with US business hours

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Travel Desk Executive will be responsible for managing and coordinating end-to-end business travel requirements for Anblicks employees and leadership across **India and the USA**.

The role will ensure timely travel arrangements, cost-effective bookings, adherence to the Company’s Travel Policy, appropriate approvals, accurate documentation, and seamless coordination with employees, vendors, Admin, HR, and Finance teams.

As the role supports Anblicks' US operations, the candidate will be required to maintain **regular working-hour overlap with the US team** and should be flexible to support urgent or time-sensitive travel requirements across different time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Travel Planning & Booking**

* Manage domestic and international business travel requirements for employees and leadership across India and the USA.
* Arrange flights, hotels, ground transportation, rental cars, and other travel-related services.
* Identify cost-effective travel options while considering business requirements, employee convenience, and Company policy.
* Handle booking modifications, cancellations, rescheduling, refunds, and travel disruptions.
* Support urgent and last-minute travel requirements, including requests received during the required US-hours overlap.
* Share complete travel itineraries and booking confirmations with travelers on time.

### **USA Travel Support**

* Provide travel desk support to employees and leadership based in or traveling within the USA.
* Coordinate domestic US travel, including flights, hotels, rental cars, and ground transportation.
* Support India-to-USA and USA-to-India international travel requirements.
* Coordinate effectively with US-based employees, Admin, HR, Finance, Sales, and Delivery teams.
* Understand and manage travel requirements across different US time zones.
* Maintain appropriate overlap with US business hours to ensure timely response and support.

### **Travel Approvals & Policy Compliance**

* Ensure appropriate business and financial approvals are obtained before confirming bookings.
* Verify that travel requests comply with the Company's Travel Policy, including travel class, hotel limits, advance booking requirements, and applicable spending limits.
* Identify and escalate exceptions or out-of-policy requests before booking.
* Maintain proper documentation and approval trails for travel transactions.

### **International Travel & Documentation**

* Coordinate international travel arrangements, including flight and hotel bookings.
* Support employees with visa-related documentation, travel insurance, invitation letters, and other travel documentation in coordination with HR/Admin.
* Track visa timelines and travel documentation requirements.
* Ensure travelers receive necessary itinerary and documentation information before travel.

### **Vendor Management & Cost Optimization**

* Coordinate with travel agencies, airlines, hotels, rental car providers, cab providers, and other travel vendors in India and the USA.
* Compare available travel options and quotations to ensure competitive pricing.
* Support negotiation of corporate rates and commercial arrangements with travel vendors.
* Monitor vendor service quality, response time, pricing, and billing accuracy.
* Identify opportunities to reduce travel costs through advance booking, preferred vendors, corporate rates, and better travel planning.

### **Billing & Finance Coordination**

* Verify travel vendor invoices against approved bookings and supporting documents before submission to Finance.
* Ensure appropriate employee, department, project/customer, and cost-center information is captured.
* Coordinate with Finance for vendor payments, employee travel advances, reimbursements, and corporate card transactions, as applicable.
* Track cancellations, refunds, airline credits, hotel refunds, and unused ticket credits.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely recovery and utilization of outstanding credits.

### **Travel MIS & Reporting**

Maintain accurate travel records and prepare periodic MIS covering:

* Employee-wise travel expenses
* Department/project/customer-wise travel expenses
* India and USA travel spend
* Domestic vs. international travel
* Airfare, hotel, rental car, and ground transportation expenses
* Booking lead time
* Cancellation and rescheduling costs
* Refunds and unused travel credits
* Policy exceptions
* Vendor-wise spend
* Travel cost trends and savings opportunities

Provide monthly travel reports to Finance/Management and highlight significant variances, exceptions, and cost-saving opportunities.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

Performance may be measured based on:

* Turnaround time for travel requests
* Travel Policy compliance
* Cost savings through fare comparison and advance booking
* Accuracy of bookings and travel documentation
* Timely resolution of urgent India and US travel requests
* Timely reconciliation of cancellations, refunds, and travel credits
* Accuracy and timeliness of Travel MIS
* Vendor performance
* Employee satisfaction with travel desk support

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Travel & Tourism, or a related field.
* **2–5 years of experience** in corporate travel management or travel desk operations.
* Experience handling **India and US corporate travel** is strongly preferred.
* Experience managing domestic and international flight, hotel, rental car, and ground transportation bookings.
* Familiarity with US travel arrangements and major US time zones will be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and MIS reporting.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Key Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------

* Strong coordination and follow-up skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* Cost-conscious and commercially aware
* Strong negotiation and vendor management skills
* Ability to manage multiple requests across different time zones
* Ability to work under pressure and handle last-minute requirements
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Good Excel and reporting skills
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Customer-service-oriented approach
* Understanding of financial controls and approval processes

**Working Hours / Shift Requirement**
-------------------------------------

This role is based in India but supports Anblicks' **India and USA operations**. The candidate must be comfortable working in a schedule that provides **regular overlap with US business hours**.

The role requires flexibility to coordinate with US-based employees and stakeholders and to address urgent travel requirements that may arise during the US working day.

Candidates should therefore be comfortable with **extended/evening working hours in India as required based on business and travel needs**.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented **Sales Coordinator** to support our sales team and ensure smooth day-to-day sales operations. In this role, you will work closely with Sales Associates, Field Sales Executives, retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and the Sales Head to manage order coordination, maintain accurate sales records, monitor inventory, and ensure timely product resupply.

You will play a key role in connecting the sales team with business partners, tracking order requirements, and supporting future sales planning. If you have strong communication and coordination skills, enjoy working with data, and can manage multiple tasks efficiently, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales Team Coordination:** Coordinate with Sales Associates and Field Sales Executives to track daily sales activities, follow up on customer requirements, resolve order-related issues, and ensure smooth communication between the field team and management.

**2. Retailer, Wholesaler & Distributor Data Management:** Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of retailers, wholesalers, and distributors, including contact details, order history, stock requirements, outstanding orders, and resupply schedules.

**3. Order Follow-ups & Resupply Coordination:** Regularly follow up with retailers, wholesalers, and distributors to understand their replenishment requirements, collect repeat orders, track pending orders, and coordinate timely resupply to prevent stock shortages.

**4. Production & Inventory Tracking:** Monitor production inventory and available stock levels to ensure product availability aligns with incoming orders and market demand. Coordinate with the relevant internal teams to identify potential shortages and communicate replenishment requirements in advance.

**5. Sales Reporting & Documentation:** Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports, order summaries, inventory updates, customer follow-up records, and other relevant documentation to support business operations and decision-making.

**6. Coordination with the Sales Head:** Work directly with the Sales Head to review sales performance, discuss market requirements, share updates on retailer and distributor demand, and assist in planning future sales activities and distribution strategies.

**7. Sales Planning & Forecasting Support:** Help identify upcoming product requirements by analyzing past orders, repeat purchase patterns, inventory movement, and feedback from field sales teams. Support the preparation of sales forecasts and resupply plans.

**8. Pending Orders & Issue Resolution:** Track delayed, incomplete, or pending orders and coordinate with the concerned teams to ensure timely resolution. Communicate order status updates to relevant stakeholders and maintain proper follow-up records.

**9. Customer Relationship Support:** Maintain professional communication with retailers, wholesalers, and distributors to strengthen business relationships, understand their concerns, and ensure a smooth and reliable ordering experience.

**10. Internal Communication & Operational Support:** Act as a coordination point between the sales team, inventory or production team, and management to ensure accurate information flow, timely updates, and efficient execution of sales operations.

Qualifications & Requirements

**Communication Skills:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate professionally with sales teams, retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and management.

**Language Proficiency:** Proficiency in Hindi and English is preferred. Knowledge of additional regional languages is an advantage.

**Organizational Skills:** Strong attention to detail, time management, and the ability to handle multiple follow-ups, maintain records, and prioritize tasks effectively.

**Data Management:** Ability to maintain accurate customer databases, order logs, inventory records, and sales reports.

**Technical Skills:** Basic to intermediate knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets is preferred. Familiarity with CRM, ERP, inventory management, or order management software is an added advantage.

**Problem-Solving Ability:** Ability to identify order discrepancies, track pending requirements, communicate stock shortages, and coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve operational issues.

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. Candidates with relevant practical experience may also be considered.

**Experience:** Freshers with strong organizational and communication skills may apply. Prior experience in sales coordination, sales operations, customer support, inventory management, or order processing is an advantage.

**Work Approach:** Must be responsible, proactive, systematic, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment that requires regular follow-ups and coordination across multiple teams.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
* Attractive incentive structure, offering additional earning potential based on sales performance.
* Opportunity to work closely with the Sales Head and understand business operations.
* Exposure to sales planning, inventory management, distribution, and customer relationship management.
* Opportunities for professional growth in sales operations and business coordination.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree preferred.

**Language:** Hindi and English preferred.

**Job Type:** Full-time.

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 **Business Descriptor:**


HSBC Asset Management is primarily responsible for driving mutual fund sales through distributor networks and client relationships, while ensuring compliance and delivering market insights to advisors and investors.

**Core responsibilities**

* Distributor \& IFA channel development: Build and manage relationships with banks, independent financial advisors (IFAs), and national distributors; expand the IFA network and deepen penetration in the assigned region.

**Additional Information**

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. description:

We take care of our employees, and they take care of our customers!


Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service\-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350\+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.


Our Mission


We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. **We love to promote from within** \- more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs \- they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!

The focus of the District Sales Executive (DSE) is on achieving results that are aligned with the overall organization and it's strategic goals. Initiative, coupled with a sense of competitive drive, and the ability to stay focused on results despite changing conditions, are the keys to achieving the performance objectives of the District Sales Executive role at Expeditors.


The DSE orchestrates involvement of multiple people in our Sales process, so that new customer revenue is consistently secured for our district office and Expeditors network. The job environment is flexible, constantly changing, and provides growth opportunity, recognition and reward for the achievement of business results. This position reports to the District Sales Manager.

**Key Deliverables**


These are the minimum results expected from a successful District Sales Executive:

* Manage an assigned territory and demonstrate extensive knowledge of potential customers and competitors in this area
* Timely data entry in our Customer Relationship Management tool
* Orchestrate customer / branch relationships and collaborate with regional Product, Service, Geo, and Knowledge Management resources
* Participate in the creation of value\-added solutions for customer's logistics needs, including supporting diagrams and cost\-benefit calculations
* Support the transition of new accounts through customer introductions, information transfer, and securing any necessary customer paperwork. When needed, support AR (accounts receivable) collection.
* Attend training \& development sessions to continue developing selling skills and updating Expeditors Product and Service knowledge
* Involvement in local trade groups, as directed by the District Sales Manager
* Take on additional assignments as required, supporting company needs

  

**Qualifications**  

* Must have at least 3\-5 years of Sales experience in Freight Forwarding industry
* The ability to meet with customers off\-site on a regular basis
* Oral and written proficiency in the English language
* Strong problem solving, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work productively both individually and in a team environment
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Self\-motivated with ability to work in a fast\-paced and constantly changing environment
* Comfortable with regular data entry on a laptop computer
* Strong rapport and relationship\-building focused
* Empowered to make quick decisions in response to changing conditions
* Extroverted, confident, enthusiastic and persuasive
* Influences others to action
* Timeliness and accountability for results

  

**Additional Information**  

Expeditors offers excellent benefits:

* Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
* Health Plan: Medical
* Life Insurance
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Training and Personnel Development Program
* Growth opportunities within the company
* Employee Referral Program Bonus

description:
Role summary

Own day\-to\-day Meta (Facebook/Instagram) advertising for ecommerce clients — from campaign build to scaling — with direct accountability for spend efficiency and revenue outcomes.

\> Key responsibilities

* Plan, launch and manage Meta ad campaigns across the full funnel: Advantage\+ Sales, prospecting, catalogue retargeting and remarketing.
* Structure and scale campaigns for D2C ecommerce — manage budgets, bidding and account structure to hit ROAS/CAC and MER targets.
* Set up and maintain catalogue/feed\-driven campaigns, audiences (lookalikes, interest, custom, exclusions) and creative testing frameworks.
* Own tracking integrity: Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), Event Match Quality, Consent Mode — coordinate with the tracking/dev team where needed.
* Run structured creative testing (angles × hooks), brief creative teams, and act on performance to refresh fatigued assets.
* Monitor daily performance, manage frequency and budget pacing, and diagnose drops using platform, GA4 and Shopify data.
* Report weekly on spend, ROAS, CAC, AOV and blended performance; flag risks and opportunities proactively.
* Stay current on Meta platform changes, policy and ad account health (bans, disapprovals, resolution).

\> Must\-have skills

* 3\+ years managing Meta Ads with demonstrable D2C/ecommerce scaling results (share account/spend scale in interview).
* Hands\-on with Advantage\+, catalogue ads, CAPI/Pixel setup, and audience strategy.
* Comfortable with Shopify, GA4 and Meta reporting; can read data and act on it, not just pull numbers.
* Strong grasp of creative\-performance relationship and testing discipline.

\> Good to have

* Experience with server\-side tracking (GTM/Stape), TikTok Ads, or Google Ads.
* Agency background managing multiple ecommerce accounts.

\> What success looks like

Sustained, profitable scaling of client accounts against blended MER/CAC targets, with clean tracking and a consistent creative testing pipeline.
